crew.overview: An aspiring musician agrees to a marriage of convenience with a soon-to-deploy Marine, but a tragedy soon turns their fake relationship all too real.
crew.title: Purple Hearts

details.biography: American television producer, writer and director. As a writer, her credits include Dawson's Creek, Wonderfalls and Cold Case. Garcia's film credits include the 1988 film Return of the Killer Tomatoes and the 2002 film The New Guy as production assistant. She wrote and directed The Lifeguard, starring Kristen Bell.
details.name: Liz W. Garcia
